$comment: Input-signal NAMES and the witness layout were recovered from the official gatekeeper.wasm's embedded FNV input-signal map and empirically validated against the official zkey: witness calc succeeds/fails exactly along the documented trap rules and proofs verify locally. The circuit itself derives the decision and asserts the supplied one, so a wrong decision fails the witness calculation (the caller then omits the proof - fail-open). Semantic encodings of vk hashes / taskId / the output commitment remain UNCONFIRMED until the platform's re-verification is observed on a real scored task; until then a failed platform-side verification costs the same -2 as omitting the proof, so attaching is never worse than decision-only.
